title: WKS Board Config
description: Presentation config for how a case type's kanban board renders. Introduced in the WKS Case Configuration Standard 2.0, extracted out of the (now removed) CaseDefinition.kanbanConfig. Board COLUMNS are always derived from the referenced case definition's `stages`; this document only customizes card presentation. Keyed to a case definition by id. Self-contained (internal $defs only).

caseDefinitionId.description: Id of the case definition this board config applies to. Columns are taken from that case definition's stages.

card.description: Which case attributes appear on each kanban card. When absent/empty, cards show only the business key and status description.

titleFields.description: Attribute names rendered in the card header.

contentFields.description: Attribute names rendered in the card body.

_id.description: Storage envelope field (e.g. MongoDB ObjectId wrapper). Not part of the logical config contract.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the WKS Case Configuration Standard this document conforms to. Absent/null is treated as the 1.0 pre-versioning baseline.
